name: Eubulus
overview: Eubulus is a male figure mentioned in the New Testament who is noted for sending greetings through the Apostle Paul to Timothy. Beyond this brief mention, Scripture does not provide further details about his tribe or additional personal notes.
namesAndTitles: The name Eubulus appears only once in Scripture, specifically in 2 Timothy 4:21. There is no provided meaning or special significance attached to his name in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Eubulus beyond his association with Paul and Timothy as indicated by his sending greetings through Paul to Timothy.
scriptureSignificance: Eubulus is significant as one of the faithful individuals who maintained fellowship and encouragement within the early Christian community. His sending greetings through Paul to Timothy highlights the interconnectedness and mutual support among believers during the apostolic era, reflecting the unity and love that characterized the body of Christ.
